subject: dispatch_source_type_data_add

observation.summary: Counting _dispatch_source_type_* anchors in the arm64e export trie yields 19. The exported set excludes _dispatch_source_type_after, which is present in OSS source.c:1429 (used by dispatch_after to build a one-shot timer source). The 20 OSS anchors differ from the 19 shipped by exactly the absent _dispatch_source_type_after; no other name in the family diverges.

claim: The shipped libdispatch arm64e binary exports 19 _dispatch_source_type_* anchors (one each for data_add, data_or, data_replace, read, write, signal, timer, interval, proc, vnode, vfs, sock, nw_channel, memorypressure, memorystatus, vm, exclaves_notification, mach_send, mach_recv), one fewer than the 20 anchors in OSS source.c because _dispatch_source_type_after is OSS-only -- the shipped binary builds dispatch_after timers via _dispatch_after's tail-call to a private helper rather than through an exported source-type vtable.
reproducer:
dyld_info -exports /usr/lib/system/introspection/libdispatch.dylib | grep -c '_dispatch_source_type_'
dyld_info -exports /usr/lib/system/introspection/libdispatch.dylib | grep -E '_dispatch_source_type_after$'
# expect: 38 across both archs (19 arm64e + 19 x86_64), and zero matches for _dispatch_source_type_after
